name: stance-split-retaliate
description: split fire on units that answer an attack by themselves: eight rangers with split fire, no order of the player, are shot at by a Red Guard and all answer it (the game's retaliation); a second Red Guard comes a moment later and some rangers take it (at least one switch, at most one per ranger: no switching back and forth); both Red Guards die within 10 s and no ranger is lost. (Needs the commits with MSG_ASSIST_STANCE.)
log: ^ASSIST stance set mask=8 value=8 percent=0 for 8 units

log.match: ^ASSIST stance split: unit \d+ leaves \d+ \(enough on its way\) for \d+
